might.name: Might
might.description: Melee attacks deal +2 damage per point.

dexterity.name: Dexterity
dexterity.description: Ranged and area attacks deal +2 damage per point.

vigor.name: Vigor
vigor.description: Gain +10 max health, +2 healing, and reduce health costs by 1 per point.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: Block gains +2, stoneskin gains +1, and illusions gain +2 health per point.

focus.name: Focus
focus.description: Intensity cards gain +1 intensity and intensity bonuses gain +2 fixed-power values per point.

fire_magick.name: Fire Magick
fire_magick.description: Burn effects gain +2 and health-cost attacks gain +2 damage per point.

ice_magick.name: Ice Magick
ice_magick.description: Attacks deal +2 damage to frozen enemies and freeze cards grant +2 block per point.

lightning_magick.name: Lightning Magick
lightning_magick.description: Attacks that shock or chain deal +2 damage per point.

air_magick.name: Air Magick
air_magick.description: Push and pull attacks deal +2 damage, and blink cards grant +2 block per point.

earth_magick.name: Earth Magick
earth_magick.description: Poison gains +2, stoneskin gains +1, and illusions gain +2 health per point.
